Join us Wednesday the Aug 26th thru Sunday Aug 30th for our Anniversary Weekend!!! One year ago we opened our doors to Brentwood and we want to celebrate the community that embraced and supported us.
The Party starts Wednesday w/ Paint Nite in the Cellar hosted by Bindhu (tickets available), followed by Free Live Music on Thursday with The Wayhighs. Friday and Saturday Chef Colin is creating a special menu for the weekend with a variety of different fresh offerings including a new seasonal menu. It all culminates on Sunday with the Acoustic stylings on Chris Ahlman during Brunch from 12pm – 3pm. Come grab a beer and a burger and join the party!!! We look forward to celebrating with all our friends and neighbors.
